note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

json.reason: Go: go/cmd/tabnas-railroad/main.go imports github.com/tabnas/json/go, and its `pickPlugin` returns `jsonplugin.Json` for `--grammar json` (also spelled '@tabnas/json', 'tabnas/json' or 'github.com/tabnas/json/go') and refuses every other name, so json is the command's one built-in grammar; the library files of the same module (go/extract.go, go/railroad.go) import only the engine. Rust: rs/Cargo.toml declares `tabnas-json` with `optional = true` under the `cli` feature, which is in `default`, and rs/src/cli.rs (compiled only under `#[cfg(feature = "cli")]` in rs/src/lib.rs) calls `tabnas_json::make()` in `grammar_from_name` for `json`, '@tabnas/json', 'tabnas/json', 'tabnas-json' or 'tabnas_json' and refuses every other name; elsewhere in rs/src the crate appears only in doc comments. TypeScript: no file in ts/src imports '@tabnas/json'; the command loads whatever module `--grammar` names with a run-time `require(moduleSpec)` (`grammarFromModule` in ts/src/bin/tabnas-railroad-cli.ts), so it needs no built-in grammar, and ts/package.json lists '@tabnas/json' under devDependencies, as the test grammar (ts/test/grammar.test.js, ts/test/ts-model-snapshot.test.js).
json.repair: Either ts/package.json declares '@tabnas/json' as an optional peer, on the ground that `tabnas-railroad --grammar @tabnas/json` (the example in the command's own help text) needs it installed; ts/src would still not import it. Or the commands leave the library packages: go/cmd/tabnas-railroad becomes a module of its own, and rs/src/cli.rs with the `tabnas-railroad` binary becomes a crate of its own, so that the non-test Go files of the module at go/ import only the engine and rs/Cargo.toml keeps `tabnas-json` under [dev-dependencies] alone, as ts/package.json keeps it under devDependencies; go/go.mod would still require json for go/grammar_test.go. On the handover page (parser/doc/handover/README.md, "Rulings"), ruling 12 moved the `alchemy` command to a repository of its own and ruling 10 says components "should not drag along unnecessary dependencies"; neither names railroad. Undecided: awaits the maintainer's ruling.
